tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch10:10-22Suppose $(M,g)$ is a connected, compact Riemannian manifold, $p \in M$, and $C \subseteq M$ is the cut locus of $p$. Prove that $C$ is homotopy equivalent to $M \setminus \{ p\} $. \end{exercise}
